title: 第15章 强大的先天体魄第16章 立即给我滚过来
slug: 太古封神第1516章直接镇压
lines: 随后，秦云依照银发女子所说，来到了那些死去的妖兽面前，然后施展极境御兽诀。
死去的妖兽体内精血迅速凝聚，然后化为了一颗妖血丹。
“前辈，这颗妖血丹蕴含的力量好强。”
秦云颇感吃惊，这只低阶妖兽实力仅有周天境，但是凝聚出来的妖血丹竟然达到了先天境的程度。
“妖兽主要靠血脉传承力量，它的父辈很可能是中阶妖兽，只不过没激发出血脉内的力量成为中阶妖兽。”
“但是它留下了中阶妖兽的力量，你提炼精血的同时诱发出了血脉力量，所以能凝练出更强的妖血丹。”
听完女子的解释，秦云点了点头。
随后，秦云炼化了妖血丹。
妖血丹血化开。
强大而霸道的力量冲入秦云体内，然后贯穿了四肢百脉。
秦云立即体会到妖血丹的可怕。
力量太霸道了。
一般修士服用的妖血丹的话，稍有不慎就会经脉碎裂废掉，严重的可能会爆体身亡。
咔咔……
秦云明显感觉到自己的身躯在变强，无论是血肉皮肤还是骨头，还是五脏六腑都变得越来越坚韧。
还有力气的增长。
秦云能察觉到力气涨了不少。
“难怪有些修士会冒险服用妖血丹了，这些妖血丹的效果太强了，只要能承受妖血丹的力量，体魄就能变得更强。”
体魄变强对修士有很大的好处，首先是体力这一块会变得更悠长，可以增加持久对敌。
而当体魄达到一定程度后，甚至都可以不动用真元，光凭身体就能打出堪比同境界的力道。
不消耗真气，光凭体魄自身带有的力道的话，那么就可以持久对敌了，哪怕以一敌多都不惧。
秦云继续朝下一只妖兽尸体走去。
施展御兽诀。
然后凝练妖血丹。
每凝练一颗，秦云当场就炼化。
随着妖血丹不断炼化，秦云的体魄越来越强，等到第七十八只妖兽所化的妖血丹被吃下后，秦云发现自己的体魄已经无法再增长了。
“前辈，妖血丹好像没用了。”
秦云不由说道。
“低阶妖兽的妖血丹效果对你没用了，要想提升就得找到中阶妖兽，刚刚那只黑色蛇蛟是中阶妖兽，它现在应该死了，你可以回去看看。”
银发女子对秦云说道。
“老祖已经杀死黑色蛇蛟了？”
秦云意外道。
见银发女子没有回话，秦云也没有再问，而是立即沿着原路返回，很快看到了大量的妖兽尸体。
大地上遍布焦黑痕迹，还有袅袅青烟升起。
秦云发现了御兽上人的尸体，他浑身如同焦炭，眼睛瞪得大大的，眼神中充满了惊骇之色。
黑色蛇蛟的尸体就在旁边，也是浑身焦黑，已经没气了。
content_en:
Afterwards, Qin Yun followed what the silver-haired woman said, came to the dead monsters, and then used the Ultimate Beast Control Technique.
The essence and blood in the body of the dead demon beast quickly condensed, and then turned into a demon blood pill.
"Senior, the power contained in this demon blood pill is so strong."
Qin Yun was quite surprised. The strength of this low-level monster was only at the Zhoutian realm, but the condensed demon blood pill actually reached the Xiantian realm.
"The demonic beast mainly relies on its bloodline to inherit its power. Its father is probably an intermediate-level demonic beast, but it just did not inspire the power in its bloodline to become an intermediate-level demonic beast."
"But it retains the power of the mid-level demon beast. When you refine the blood essence, you also induce the power of blood, so you can condense a stronger demon blood pill."
After listening to the woman's explanation, Qin Yun nodded.
Later, Qin Yun refined the Demon Blood Pill.
The blood of the demon blood elixir melts.
Powerful and domineering power rushed into Qin Yun's body, and then penetrated all the veins in his limbs.
Qin Yun immediately realized how terrifying the Demon Blood Pill was.
The power is too overbearing.
If the demon blood pills taken by ordinary monks are not careful, the meridians will be broken and destroyed, and in serious cases, the body may explode and die.
Kaka...
Qin Yun clearly felt that his body was getting stronger, whether it was flesh, skin, bones, or internal organs, they were becoming tougher and tougher.
There is also an increase in strength.
Qin Yun could notice that his strength had increased a lot.
"No wonder some monks take the risk of taking demon blood pills. The effect of these demon blood pills is too strong. As long as you can withstand the power of the demon blood pills, your body will become stronger."
Being physically stronger has great benefits for monks. First of all, physical strength will become longer, which can increase the number of lasting enemies.
And when your physical fitness reaches a certain level, you can even exert strength comparable to those in the same realm without using your true energy.
If you don't consume your true energy and just rely on the strength of your body, you can fight against the enemy for a long time, even if you are one against many, you will not be afraid.
Qin Yun continued to walk towards the next monster corpse.
Use the Beast Control Technique.
Then condense the demon blood pill.
Every time he condenses one, Qin Yun refines it on the spot.
As the demon blood pill continued to be refined, Qin Yun's body became stronger and stronger. After the demon blood pill transformed from the seventy-eighth demon beast was eaten, Qin Yun found that his body could no longer grow.
"Senior, the Demon Blood Pill seems to be useless."
Qin Yun couldn't help but say.
"The demon blood pill effect of low-level monsters is useless to you. If you want to improve, you have to find mid-level monsters. The black snake dragon just now is a mid-level monster. It should be dead now. You can go back and take a look."
The silver-haired woman said to Qin Yun.
"Has the ancestor killed the black snake dragon?"
Qin Yun said unexpectedly.
Seeing that the silver-haired woman did not reply, Qin Yun did not ask any more questions, but immediately returned along the original path, and soon saw a large number of monster corpses.
There were scorch marks all over the ground, and green smoke was rising.
Qin Yun discovered the body of the master of beast control. His whole body was like charcoal, his eyes were wide open, and his eyes were filled with horror.
The body of the black snake dragon was nearby. It was also charred and lifeless.
